crossRefs.note: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.
“Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.
The range of the mountains is his pasture, He searches after every green thing.
His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”
“See now, behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.
Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.
He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the…
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.
You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

parallels.note: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

translations.web: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
translations.bsb: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
translations.kjv: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat:
translations.asv: and to every beast of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for food: and it was so.
